title: Tier
description: ThrottlingPolicy schema from WSO2 API Manager

attributes.description: Custom attributes added to the policy policy

requestCount.description: Maximum number of requests which can be sent within a provided unit time

dataUnit.description: Unit of data allowed to be transfered. Allowed values are "KB", "MB" and "GB"

totalTokenCount.description: Maximum number of total tokens which can be used within a provided unit time

promptTokenCount.description: Maximum number of prompt tokens which can be used within a provided unit time

completionTokenCount.description: Maximum number of completion tokens which can be used within a provided unit time

tierPlan.description: This attribute declares whether this policy is available under commercial or free

stopOnQuotaReach.description:
By making this attribute to false, you are capabale of sending requests
even if the request count exceeded within a unit time

monetizationProperties.description: Properties of a tier plan which are related to monetization
